title: VP Strategy AM hitlist + timeblocks
content:
Quick morning capture — purpose: a sharp, skimmable set of things I must move today and asks I can land by EOD. Treat as working scratchpad; will prune into calendar + follow-ups after standups.

Today context: travel tomorrow (SFO → LHR) so heavy on decisions today; two external customer meetings (Dedicated pilot review at 11:30, Security SOC intake at 15:00). Keep ask list short; no more than 6 items to progress.

Top priorities (must-dos)
- Finalize Dedicated capacity renewal terms (legal redlines) — call with finance at 09:40. Outcome: sign-off threshold and fallback pricing (if commit drops >20%).
- Approve Private deployment SOW for Pilot-3 (E. Park) — need final scope on HA and kms integration. Sign by 16:00 or push to Monday.
- Greenlight Redwood Console telemetry retention plan for enterprise tier — decision: 90 vs 180 days (cost + sales asks). Document outcome in Confluence.
- Customer interview prep: Acme Health (15:00 SOC intake) — 3 core questions to surface: data residency concerns, KMS + HSM expectations, SLA escalation path.

Micro-asks (3–10 minute asks to delegate)
- Lina: summarize 2-line impact of lowering default streaming window for hosted API (ops + docs implications). Slack DM.
- Priya: quick email draft to partner onboarding with milestone checklist for Private pilot.
- Ops: confirm infra reserve for Dedicated burst on 2026-03-22 (1h check).

Timeblocks (rough)
- 07:30–08:15: inbox triage + prep talking points for 09:00 all-hands.
- 08:30–09:10: 1:1 with Head of Product (align console rollout narrative).
- 09:40–10:10: call with Finance (Dedicated renewal options).
- 10:30–11:15: deep work — sign-off doc + short Confluence update.
- 11:30–12:15: Dedicated pilot customer review (external).
- 12:15–13:00: buffer / lunch / quick PR review.
- 13:00–14:00: leadership sync (roadmap + SRE capacity).
- 14:00–14:30: prep for SOC intake + share 3 Qs with security lead.
- 15:00–15:45: Acme Health SOC intake (external).
- 16:00–16:30: wrap — close micro-asks, tag follow-ups for Monday.

Meeting prep snippets (one-line notes for each)
- Finance (09:40): show incremental margin model for Dedicated at commit sizes 50k/100k/200k tokens/day. Ask: minimum acceptable margin?
- Dedicated pilot review (11:30): verify metrics (p99 latency, tokens/sec) and failure modes; propose fallback model variant for spike traffic.
- Leadership sync (13:00): decision point on telemetry retention and rollout phasing; align on sales enablement timeline.
- Acme Health (15:00): confirm encryption-at-rest key model, support windows, and compliance docs they need.

Parking lot / later items
- Revisit caching recommendation from Optimize team (batching thresholds) — schedule 1-hour deep dive next week.
- Deck for board: add a slide showing cost-per-inference trend by quantization level.
- Draft partner program terms for EU channel partner.

Today failure modes to avoid
- Overcommit to scope for Private pilot (keep MVP narrow).
- Leaving telemetry decision unresolved before sales push — treat as blocking for enterprise deals.

End-of-day deliverables (EOD check)
- Signed dedicated renewal decision (or clear next steps + owners).
- SOW comments sent to customer for Pilot-3.
- Quick note in Confluence summarizing telemetry decision and follow-up owners.
- Slack pings sent for micro-asks that are still open.

Notes to self (stickies)
- Be explicit with customers about fallback policies (model variants/regions) — reduces negotiation friction.
- If legal pushes new indemnity language, escalate to CEO for one-off exception.

Mood/energy: 7/10 — sharpened by travel prep. Keep coffee on hand and blocks protected.

Random reminders (non-blocking)
- Send Amelia quick congrats on her new hire; schedule 15-min intro next week.
- Pull metrics for p99 latency last 72h for the Dedicated pool and attach to customer review notes.

End of capture.
